1.w: A Song for the Ascents. I lift up my eyes to the hills, from where my help does come.

2.w: My help [is] from YHWH, the Maker of the heavens and the earth.

3.w: He will not give your foot to the slipping; the One guarding you will not slumber.

4.w: Behold, He does not slumber, and He does not sleep—the One guarding Israel.

5.w: YHWH [is] the One guarding you; YHWH [is] your shade on your right hand.

6.w: By day the sun will not strike you, nor the moon in the night.

7.w: YHWH will guard you from all evil; He will guard your soul.

8.w: YHWH will guard your going out and your coming in, from now even to forever.
